from pathlib import Path
import os, re, subprocess
roots=[Path('tests/zigbee_device_emulator/managed_components'),Path('managed_components'),Path('components'),Path.home()/'esp',Path.home()/'.espressif']
pat=re.compile(r'(zone.?status.*change|status.*change.*zone|ias_zone.*status|ZONE_STATUS_CHANGE|IAS_ZONE_STATUS|status_change_notification|zone_status_change)',re.I)
seen=set()
for root in roots:
    if not root.exists():
        continue
    print('ROOT='+str(root))
    count=0
    for p in root.rglob('*'):
        if count>=500:
            break
        if not p.is_file() or p.suffix.lower() not in {'.h','.c','.cc','.cpp','.inc'}:
            continue
        try:
            text=p.read_text(errors='ignore')
        except Exception:
            continue
        for i,line in enumerate(text.splitlines(),1):
            if pat.search(line):
                key=(str(p),i,line.strip())
                if key not in seen:
                    seen.add(key); print(f'{p}:{i}:{line.strip()}'); count+=1
                    if count>=500: break
